CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation linked to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red set) is identified and paired with an origin/organization entry, and the origin metadata separates content from status.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation linking to content presentation/access is present.

C.rationale: Report explicitly lists identified content sets (colour-labelled coordinates) with keys indicating current representations.

D.rationale: Content coordinates are provided separately from origin/status metadata, distinguishing identity from presentation/source.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

O.rationale: The text reports how contents are organized/presented (current vs candidate peaks) and provides origin metadata indicating representation organization/access.
